standard-dialogue-before-prince-ali-resc.npc: Hello. I am Osman. What can I assist you with?

options.text: You don't seem very tough. Who are you?

steps.player: You don't seem very tough. Who are you?

steps.npc: I work for Al Kharid's Emir. That is all you need to know.

steps.player: Nothing. I'm just being nosy.

steps.npc: That bothers me not. The secrets of Al Kharid protect themselves.

standard-dialogue-after-prince-ali-rescu.npc: Well done. A great rescue. I will remember you if I have anything dangerous to do.

options.text: I'd like to talk about sq'irks.

steps.text: See Sorceress's Garden-related Dialogue section below

options.text: I want to talk to you about Sophanem.

steps.player: I want to talk to you about Sophanem.

steps.npc: Yes, quite the interesting set of events. I suspect I won't be heading back down there any time soon.

steps.text: If the player never took Kaleef's dagger from the scarab:

steps.npc: That reminds me, I have Kaleef's dagger here for you. I imagine you'll find it rather useful.

steps.text: Osman gives you a Keris dagger.

steps.player: Thanks.

options.text: Do you have any more of those daggers?

steps.player: Do you have any more of those daggers?

steps.npc: Of course. They're a standard piece of equipment for us. The enchantments upon them make them very useful against both scarabs and kalphites. If you want, I can sell you another for 20,000 coins?

steps.player: I'll take one.

steps.text: If the player has 20k coins on them:
Osman hands you a Keris dagger in exchange for 20,000 coins.
If the player doesn't have 20k coins on them:

steps.player: Actually, I don't seem to have enough money on me.

steps.text: If the player's inventory is full:

steps.player: Actually, I don't seem to have enough room to carry it.
That's too much.

steps.npc: Well you know where I am if you reconsider.

options.text: What are your plans for Menaphos now?

steps.player: What are your plans for Menaphos now?

steps.npc: I think you already know the answer to that.

steps.player: I'm not allowed to know, am I?

steps.npc: No.

steps.player: Let's talk about something else.

steps.npc: As you wish.

steps.player: I should go.

steps.npc: Until next time.

steps.player: I need to go.

steps.npc: Until next time.

options.text: I'd like to talk about sq'irks.

steps.text: If player has sq'irk juice in their inventory:

steps.player: I have some sq'irk juice for you.

steps.text: Osman imparts some Thieving advice to you ([amount] Thieving experience points) as a reward for the sq'irk juice.

steps.npc: Thank you very much [player name]. If you get some more sq'irks be sure to come back.

steps.player: I will. It's been a pleasure doing business with you.
I'd like to talk about sq'irks.
Where am I meant to find sq'irks?

steps.npc: There is a sorceress near the south-eastern edge of Al Kharid who grows them. Once upon a time, we considered each other friends.

steps.player: What happened?

steps.npc: We fell out, and now she won't give me any more fruit.

steps.player: So all I have to do is ask her for some fruit for you?

steps.npc: I doubt it will be that easy. She is not renowned for her generosity and is very secretive about her garden's location.

steps.player: Oh come on, it should be easy enough to find.

steps.npc: Her garden has remained hidden even to me - the chief spy of Al Kharid. I believe her garden must be hidden by magical means.

steps.player: This should be an interesting task. How many sq'irks do you want?

steps.npc: I'll reward you for as many as you can get your hands on, but could you please squeeze the fruit into a glass first?

steps.player: I've another question about sq'irks.

steps.npc: What would you like to know?

steps.player: Thanks for the information.

options.text: Why can't you get the sq'irks yourself?

steps.player: Why can't you get the sq'irks yourself?

steps.npc: I may have mentioned that I had a falling out with the Sorceress. Well, unsurprisingly, she refuses to give me any more of her garden's produce.

options.text: How should I squeeze the fruit?

steps.player: How should I squeeze the fruit?

steps.npc: Use a pestle and mortar to squeeze the sq'irks. Make sure you have an empty glass with you to collect the juice.

options.text: Is there a reward for getting these sq'irks?

steps.player: Is there a reward for getting these sq'irks?

steps.npc: Of course there is. I am a generous man. I'll teach you the art of Thieving for your troubles.

steps.player: How much training will you give?

steps.npc: That depends on the quantity and ripeness of the sq'irks you put into the juice.

steps.player: That sounds fair enough.

options.text: What's so good about sq'irk juice then?

steps.player: What's so good about sq'irk juice then?

steps.npc: Ah it's sweet, sweet nectar for a thief or spy; it makes light fingers lighter, fleet feet flightier and comes in four different colours for those who are easily amused.

steps.text: Osman starts salivating at the thought of sq'irk juice.

steps.player: It wouldn't have addictive properties, would it?

steps.npc: It only holds power over those with poor self-control, something which I have an abundance of.

steps.player: I see.

crack-the-clue-iii.npc: Well done. I have new information to share with you.

crack-the-clue-iii.text: You've found a new special clue! However, a magical force prevents you from putting this item in your inventory!
Interface showing the next clue opens.
